edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: ApoB has a biologically plausible route to worse cardiovascular disease, and the mechanism is consistent with the kinds of tissues or systems most directly exposed.
edges.summary: What makes this pair believable is not one flashy paper but the way the literature stacks up: the 2026 Emara meta analysis in Endocrinol Diabetes Metab already points to apob tracks with higher risk or worse outcomes, and later studies mostly refine the size of the effect rather than overturning it. In practice this reads more like a real risk signal than a one-off finding.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
